items.title: Neal Caine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: it’s ‘cause he has a unique big ass sound that, you know it’s him instantly.

ctx.x: Yeah, I have often thought that the bass is one of the harder instruments to show a personality. And there’s people that stick out in my mind, like Buster Williams, who God almighty, the sound he had. And I don’t know if it’s just ‘cause partly they knew how to record him or something, but.
No. Well they probably did, but it’s ‘cause he has a unique big ass sound that, you know it’s him instantly. Right?
